subject: Confused about the refund for my coffee machine
body: Hi, I bought a coffee machine at your Shenzhen Nanshan store a few weeks ago. I'd been saving up for it because I finally have a small kitchen setup at home and wanted to make proper coffee instead of instant every morning. The machine itself is fine, but it's just not working out for me, so I went back to the store to return it. That's when things got confusing. I was told there would be some kind of fee taken off the refund, and honestly I don't remember anyone mentioning that when I bought it. I checked the receipt and didn't see anything obvious either. I'm not trying to make a fuss, but it feels off to lose money on something I'm already disappointed about. Could someone explain what that charge is actually for? I'd appreciate a straight answer before I decide what to do next.
